name: Fényeslitke (Hungary)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Fényeslitke (a quartered light blue and green shield with a sun, poplars and an apple) between the name FÉNYESLITKE above and KÖZSÉG below in tan.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
